- Invoice recipient: we can route invoices to billing@acmeanalytics.com. If you prefer a separate payor entity, please indicate the payor name and payor email and we’ll add the payor to the invoice routing.
- PO: once you send the PO we’ll match it to the renewal amendment. Please include the deal id (DEAL-2026-ACME-42) on the PO.
- Tax docs: please attach the W9 when you send the PO (or drop both in reply).
- EFT/ACH: Ben (cc’d) will share our ACH template and onboarding steps so your payments team can complete setup.

I’ll prepare the renewal amendment (term + capacity top-up + Net-45) and route it to you for signature via DocuSign. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow. 

If you want the invoice addressed to a different entity for this renewal (e.g., an EU legal entity or a procurement-managed payor), flag the exact legal name and billing email and we’ll map it on our side.

Thanks — cc’ing Ben to drive the EFT details.
